skill.name: lark-task
skill.description: Manage Lark tasks and task lists with lark-cli. Create, search, update, assign, organize, complete, reopen, remind, comment, and attach files with confirmation before writes.
skill.summary: Manage Lark tasks, task lists, assignments, reminders, comments, and attachments through lark-cli.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: All 185 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, fixed documentation links, placeholder task identifiers, official AppLink examples, and Chinese prose. No prompt injection, malicious intent, concealed payload, arbitrary path handling, system reconnaissance, or active network request was found.

content.user_title: Manage Lark Tasks and Task Lists
content.value_statement: Manual task updates across Lark can be slow and inconsistent. This skill uses lark-cli to search, create, update, organize, and report tasks.
actual_capabilities: Creates tasks with summaries, descriptions, assignees, followers, due dates, and task list placement.
Lists and searches tasks using completion, date, creator, follower, and assignee filters.
Updates task details and manages parent task relationships.
Completes, reopens, comments on, assigns, and follows tasks.
Creates task lists, adds tasks, and manages task list members.
Uploads one relative local file up to 50 MB as a task attachment.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, an authenticated Lark account, and the necessary Lark permission scopes.
Some search and listing operations require a user identity and cannot use an application identity.
Attachment uploads accept one relative file from the current working directory per command.
Results depend on the tasks and task lists visible to the authenticated identity.

use_cases.title: Plan Personal Work
use_cases.description: Review incomplete tasks, track due dates, and update progress from one conversation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Team Assignments
use_cases.description: Create tasks, assign owners, add followers, and confirm delivery details with the team.

use_cases.title: Organize Project Task Lists
use_cases.description: Create task lists, add existing tasks, manage members, and track project work.

prompt_templates.title: List My Open Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: List my incomplete Lark tasks due this week. Show each task name, due time, assignee, and link.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Assigned Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark task named {{task_name}}, due {{due_date}}, assigned to {{assignee}}. Confirm all write details before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Project Task List
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a task list named {{list_name}}, add {{members}}, and create these tasks: {{tasks}}. Confirm the complete plan before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Reorganize Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Find tasks related to me since {{start_date}}, identify overdue items, move {{task_ids}} into {{tasklist}}, and update owners or due dates after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Show my incomplete tasks due today.
output_examples.output: Found two incomplete tasks due today: Review launch copy at 15:00 and Approve release checklist at 17:30. Each result includes its Lark link.

output_examples.input: Create a task named Prepare Q3 forecast for Alex, due Friday.
output_examples.output: Confirmed the task details and created Prepare Q3 forecast for Alex with Friday as the due date. The result includes the task identifier and link.

output_examples.input: Attach report.pdf to the quarterly review task.
output_examples.output: Confirmed the target and uploaded report.pdf from the current working directory. The result includes the attachment identifier and available link.

best_practices: Confirm task identifiers, assignees, dates, and list placement before every write operation.
Use task GUID values from AppLinks instead of display task numbers.
Apply focused filters and pagination limits when reviewing large task collections.
anti_patterns: Do not perform task or task list changes before confirming the requested action.
Do not use display task numbers where the API requires a task GUID.
Do not upload absolute paths or files outside the current working directory.

faq.question: Can this skill create and update Lark tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create tasks and update supported fields after confirming the requested write operation.

faq.question: Can it manage task lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create task lists, add tasks, search lists, and manage list members.

faq.question: Can it search every task in a workspace?
faq.answer: It can only return tasks visible to the authenticated identity and allowed by granted permissions.

faq.question: Can it upload task attachments?
faq.answer: Yes. It uploads one relative local file up to 50 MB per command.

faq.question: Which authentication identity does it use?
faq.answer: Identity requirements vary by operation. Personal task searches require a user identity, while other operations follow Lark authentication rules.

faq.question: Does it confirm changes before execution?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflows require user confirmation before task and task list write operations.
